title: Leases and TTLs: claims and locks auto-expire; sweeps release them
subject: leases-and-ttls
ratio: Claims and file locks carry TTLs and auto-expire; sweeps release expired holdings, so a crashed or stalled agent returns its work to the pool instead of blocking the DAG. No agent may hold a claim or a lock without a TTL bound, and no new claim or lock class may ship without one.
dicta: Bootstrap-seeded at generation 0; no P-number for the invariant itself, so tier 2 is not honestly available (CD6); tier 3 rests on T-010, which exercised lock contention, expiry and crash-recovery steal, verdicted done by harness-verifier (events.jsonl ts 2026-07-04T04:51:31Z). Corrective history, cited as history and not re-promulgated (CD5): P-004 extended lock coverage to recontext evidence writes; P-005 fixed the TTL-floor comparison so short TTLs stopped expiring near-instantly. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-03.
scope_conditions: role:any agent holding a claim lease or a file lock
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a lease or lock class without TTL is introduced, or sweep behavior is removed.
validity_conditions: state.json limits carries lock_ttl_seconds_default and claim_lease_seconds_default
